Please Consider the Situation of Ukrainian Dota 2 Players
7 hours ago
[ФР] Дикограй
We are asking Valve to consider the reality Ukrainian players face and introduce a fairer, more individual approach to reviewing reports and disconnects caused by emergencies.

Could Valve consider better protection against abusive mass reporting and a more careful review of disconnects caused by power outages or other war-related emergencies?
We want to enjoy Dota 2 and play fairly, just like everyone else. We ask for a system that can distinguish intentional griefing from circumstances beyond a player's control and prevent the abuse of the reporting system.

Dota 2's Overwatch System Is Ridiculous
21 Oct @ 2:43pm
Naktre
I'm saying that if you're going to punish someone, the absolute minimum should be explaining WHY.

Give us the match ID. Give us the report category. Show us the timestamp or the incident that resulted in the conviction.

You don't even have to reveal who reported us!

I'm genuinely willing to review my mistakes and improve. But Valve's system gives me absolutely nothing to learn from.

A punishment system that provides no explanation isn't teaching players to behave better.
